reason: Primary purpose is user interface layout customization for the DSH web GUI: the plugin rearranges panels into a VSCode-style arrangement with left tabs, centered content, and right dock behavior when files are open. Evidence from README and manifest metadata shows it is a web-only DSH profile plugin that modifies page layout behavior without adding external integrations or automation beyond UI rearrangement.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于重排 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面布局，提供左侧工作区/文件切换栏、文件打开时居中的编辑区，以及右侧会话停靠面板的 VSCode 风格布局。
summaries.en: This plugin reworks the DeepSeek Harness web interface into a VSCode-style layout with a left workspace/file rail, centered content, and a right-docked conversation panel while editing.

capabilities: Browser-side UI layout modification via injected styles and DOM changes
DSH web profile integration through bundle patching
Context-sensitive panel switching based on preview/file-open state

reasons.code: The client side overrides the frame grid with an important stylesheet and reassigns grid columns to produce a VSCode-like layout.
The plugin injects a left tab rail and monitors preview-column visibility to dock conversation and editor areas dynamically.
It is registered as a DSH web plugin bundle with a profile patch and client entry points, indicating runtime UI injection at boot.
